Where pet hair hides, and how we get it

Good pet hair cleaning starts with knowing where fur settles.

Floors

  • Carpets and rugs vacuumed, with extra attention on favorite napping spots
  • Edges and corners vacuumed, where fur tumbleweeds collect
  • Hard floors vacuumed first, then mopped, so hair gets picked up instead of pushed around
  • The floor around food and water bowls wiped

Furniture

  • Loose pet hair removed from the sofa, chairs and cushions your pets claim (surface hair removal, not upholstery shampooing)
  • Reachable surfaces dusted, where hair and dander settle

Baseboards, fans and glass

  • Baseboards spot-cleaned, where hair clings along the edges
  • Ceiling fan blades and blinds dusted
  • Nose prints and paw smudges wiped from glass doors

Baseboards, blinds and fans are part of every deep clean, and recurring visits work through them on a rotation.

Calm, careful cleaning around your pets

Some pets supervise every room; others hide under the bed until we leave. Either way, we work calmly and give them their space.

  • Friendly dogs and curious cats are welcome to hang around while we clean.
  • Nervous pets may be happier in a crate or a closed room. Tell us which room and we'll work around it.
  • Doors, gates and pet doors stay the way you tell us.

Tell us about your pets when you book

The booking form asks about pets. Use your booking notes for the details:

  • What pets you have, and their names
  • Whether they'll be loose, crated or in a closed room
  • Doors or gates that need to stay closed
  • Problem spots, like the couch the dog sleeps on
  • Any products you'd like us to avoid

Eco-friendly, pet-safe products

Paws touch every floor and noses touch everything else, so what we clean with matters. Our eco-friendly house cleaning across Dallas–Fort Worth uses pet-safe products that are tough on dirt and gentle on your home's surfaces. Prefer a product your vet recommends, or one you already trust? Leave it out, mention it in your booking notes, and we'll use yours.

One tip: keep pets off freshly mopped floors until they're dry.

Recurring plans: the best fit for pet homes

Pets shed every day, so a one-time clean fades fast. Most pet owners do best with weekly or every-other-week visits that keep the hair from building up. Start with a deep clean to reset the baseboards, blinds and corners, then let a recurring plan keep it there. For a limited time, recurring clients get a reduced rate on every visit.

We try to send the same cleaner each time, so they get to know your home, your routine and your pets.

A local team you can trust

Every team member is background checked, we're 5.0-star rated on Google, and we're open seven days a week, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM. Our English-speaking cleaners make it easy to explain your pets' quirks. Payment is collected after the clean is complete.

Do my pets need to be put away?

Not unless you'd prefer it. If yours are nervous around visitors or the vacuum, a crate or closed room usually makes the visit easier for them.

Are your products safe for pets?

We use eco-friendly, pet-safe products. If you'd rather we use your own, leave them out and note it when you book.
